positive_snippets:

The food was delicious, with plenty of options for every taste. The location is perfect — peaceful yet close to main attractions. Overall, it’s a great place for a relaxing and comfortable stay. Highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

I had a wonderful stay at Hotel Cloud Bay. The rooms were very clean, spacious, and well-maintained. The environment was peaceful, and everything was properly managed, which made my stay very comfortable.

The staff was polite, professional, and always ready to help. The owner was also very good and polite, always checking if everything was fine, and helping in every way possible. The food was perfect — tasty, fresh, and served well.

In every way, the hotel was excellent, and I had no complaints at all. Overall, it was a great experience, and I would definitely recommend Hotel Cloud Bay to everyone. I would love to visit again!
negative_snippets:
Price was charged more from what was told while booking on the call on Oyo customer care.
More over there was no towel in the room.
The matress was very poor quality. With springs and so noisy.

I booked this hotel online at a reasonable price. When I arrived, the receptionist asked if I had booked online and if I had paid the booking price online. I confirmed both, and he seemed a bit angry. He then explained at length how he was not satisfied with customers making online payments for discounts, as it meant a cost to him. He even implied he might deny my booking and not allow me to check in.
After listening to him for about 15 to 20 minutes, I finally received my keys. I took two water bottles from him and went to my room.

My recommendation for future guests:
If you are planning to visit this hotel, it's best to check availability and pay directly at the hotel instead of booking or paying online. Based on my experience, they might create issues if your booking and payment are made online.

Overall, the room was quite small but acceptable for one or two nights at a reasonable price. The hotel's location is about 1.5 km off the main road, making it a bit difficult to locate.
